name: legacy-exploration-upgraded
reason: layer 6 (ws3-l6-legacy-tool-adapter): a persisted, presentation-less Read tool call is upgraded at read time to the fileRead item the bridge emits today, so the row is a file-read row with the same path, the same derived activity intent, the same title and the same 'Explored N files' bundle as before #2232. The same adapter upgrades Grep/Glob to search items (pinned by packages/domain/test/legacy-thread-events.test.ts); the corpus holds no persisted Grep/Glob call, so that reshape has no entry here.

name: legacy-plan-rows
reason: #2232 (layer 5): persisted codex `turn/plan/updated` notifications decode into planSteps items at read time, so old codex threads show their plan snapshots (the window no longer excludes the event type).

name: delegation-from-children
reason: #2232 (layer 5): the Agent/Task/spawnAgent/resumeAgent name set is deleted; a tool call that other rows name as their parentToolCallId becomes the delegation row structurally.

name: delegation-rows-gain-v3-fields
reason: #2192 (layer 1): every delegation row carries `childRef` and `background`; a persisted tool-call delegation has no child ref and is foreground, so both are null/false against the main baseline.

name: parented-rows-surface
reason: #2232 (layer 5): a row whose parentToolCallId named a call outside the delegation name set (Claude task notifications under Monitor/TaskOutput) was dropped at the root; it now nests under that call, which the structural rule makes the delegation row.

name: legacy-plan-rows
reason: #2232 (layer 5), consequence: a persisted codex plan snapshot now renders as a plan-steps row between two assistant texts, so the first text is no longer a standalone visible response and folds into the turn — exactly what a live codex thread does when the bridge emits planSteps between texts (3 texts in 2 codex threads).

name: activity-intents-key-dropped
reason: older mobile builds are not supported (the app ships with the server), so the `activityIntents` key the server kept on every tool row for them is gone from the wire; against the main baseline, whose tool rows carry `activityIntents: []`, the only difference on a tool row that stays a tool row is the removed key.

name: legacy-replayed-read-deduplicated
reason: layer 6: a Read the provider replayed under the same call id (a resumed Claude session re-emitting its history) projected as two tool rows; the fileRead item family merges by item id, so the replay is one file-read row (2 calls in 1 thread).
